Description.Name: Operation RAT Service Ribbon
Description.Details:
Darius taps a short AFFS communique onto your desk.

"{CompanyName} is authorized the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDecoration_Davion_OperationRATServiceRibbon],Operation RAT Service Ribbon]] for service under Federated Suns command during [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreOpRAT],Operation RAT]]."

"The full citation is logged under Decorations in the Captain's Quarters."

Description.Name: Logged
Description.Details: The citation is entered in the company record. You can review decorations from the Captain's Quarters.
